TEXT
Dreams are the engine of human progress. Every great achievement in history began as a dream in someone's mind. When the Wright brothers dreamed of flying, people laughed at them; today, planes cross the oceans in hours. When doctors dreamed of defeating deadly diseases, many said it was impossible; today, millions of lives are saved by vaccines. Dreams give us a goal, a direction and the energy to keep going when times are hard. However, a dream without action is just an illusion. Those who only dream but never work will achieve nothing. The secret of success is to combine big dreams with hard work, patience and determination. As the saying goes, "A goal without a plan is just a wish." So dare to dream, but also dare to act; only then can dreams become reality.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Why are dreams called "the engine of human progress"?   (2 marks)
2) Give two examples from the text of dreams that became reality.   (2 marks)
3) Why is "a dream without action just an illusion"?   (2 marks)
4) According to the text, what is the secret of success?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verbs in the past simple: When the Wright brothers (dream) ______ of flying, people (laugh) ______ at them.   (2 marks)
2) Put into the passive: "Vaccines save millions of lives."   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Those ______ only dream but never work will achieve nothing.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "success" = ______.   (1 mark)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
"Can dreams become reality?" Write a composition (about 12-14 lines) giving your opinion, with arguments and examples (from famous people or your own life). Use linkers.
